dataset.name: FLEX-PSI69 Flame Extinguishment Experiment experimental table

engine.method: deterministic question-to-evidence pipeline; no machine learning, no LLM, no invented values; every number recomputed from the raw table or quoted from a frozen, hash-verified analysis artifact
integrity: no unit assignment to the unresolved burning-rate column
no causal claims from observational comparisons
no synchronized time claims (clock domains unreconciled)

questions.question: How do methanol and heptane experimental outcomes differ?
questions.caveat: recorded labels, not measured physics; 'Disruption' undefined

questions.question: How do their recorded burn-duration distributions differ?
questions.caveat: descriptive; conditional on independence; start/stop undocumented

questions.question: What evidence exists for the relationship between oxygen concentration and experimental outcomes?
questions.caveat: O2 confounded with diluent family and series outside the air family

questions.question: Which experiments are comparable under specified oxygen/diluent conditions?

parameters.o2_mf: optional: restrict cells to one oxygen level

questions.caveat: comparability is within-cell; identical reported values do not guarantee identical actual composition

questions.question: What evidence exists for pressure-related differences?
questions.caveat: pressure and diluent confounded above 800 mmHg; no effect claimed

questions.question: Which findings are sensitive to data-quality issues?
questions.caveat: quantified for the initial-diameter contrast; duration robust

questions.question: What information is missing that prevents a stronger conclusion?
